policy: Evaluate every held-out row whose labels all map to exactly one positive/negative/neutral group. Exclude ambiguous-only, mixed-valence and neutral-plus-emotion rows. Use official sentiment_dict.json, with neutral label explicitly neutral. No text-based selection or test-set tuning.
report: accuracy, balanced accuracy, per-class support, confusion matrix, exclusions, hashes
scope: Independent human-labelled Reddit comments; not live lounge chat, not a new annotation by this agent.
